claude.performance_metric: no divestiture; $239.0M KCG-attributed non-U.S. NOLs fully valuation-allowanced; no goodwill impairment identified (FY2020)
claude.rationale: p5 is coded 1 because the acquirer's FY2020 10-K documents realized operations-vs-organization integration friction: "consolidations in staff and technology following the Acquisition of KCG" plus recurring "Termination of office leases" write-offs for space vacated "as part of the effort to integrate and consolidate office space in connection with the Acquisition of KCG," evidencing headcount/facility consolidation against the acquired organization over time. p4 is uncertain because the slice documents no product/process interface disruption; the record is limited to KCG-named disclosures and provides no standalone product-line/operations coherence evidence. No documented evidence of controlling-intent archetype incoherence (t1) or business-model incompatibility (t2) appears in the slice, and the entity's early deregistration leaves no standalone financial trajectory to assess those channels, so both are uncertain.

grok.performance_metric: no goodwill impairment; full valuation allowance on $44.9M KCG-related DTA
grok.rationale: The slice documents only routine post-acquisition consolidation (office-space termination/subleasing and staff/technology consolidation tied to the KCG acquisition) and does not describe any realized product-line/operations incoherence, so p4_pathway is 0. Those same integration steps are framed as ordinary consolidate-and-vacate activity, with no evidence that operations broke against people/management/culture over time, so p5_pathway is 0. No controlling-intent archetype incoherence or business-model incompatibility is documented.

openai.performance_metric: $44.9 million KCG-related deferred tax asset fully valuation-allowed in 2020
openai.rationale: The slice documents continued staff, technology, and office-space consolidation following the KCG acquisition, but does not report that the acquired product line failed to align with operating processes; therefore p4 is coded 0. The office closures and lease-termination expenses are described as consolidation efforts, not as an operations-versus-people, management, or culture fracture, so p5 is coded 0.
